title: citrus × aurantium subf. iyo
intro: Citrus × aurantium subf. iyo, commonly known as Yuzu, is a citrus plant that is a natural hybrid of Citrus junos and Citrus reticulata. Yuzu is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety due to its adaptogenic properties, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Yuzu are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonene, linalool, and beta-pinene, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Yuzu may also contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function.
